title: ZAINAB KE DULAAREY
body:
SHABBIR PA QURBAA'N HUWE ZAINAB KE DULAAREY
YUN WADA WAFA KARGAYE ZAINAB KE DULAAREY
<<DIVIDER>>
1.SEHROZ KI THI TASHNALABI DHASHT ME PHIR BHI
MURJHAYE HUWE CHEHROU PE EK TAAZAGI AAYI
JAB RAN KI RIZA PA GAYE ZAINAB KE DULAREY

ASGHER KI TARAF DEKH KE JOH MAA NE KAHA THA
US AZM PE QAYAM RAHE ZAINBAB KE DULAREY

TAR KHOON ME HONE LAGE ZAINAB KE DULAREY

MAIDAA’N ME GAYE SHA-HE-DEEN ABBAS KO LEKER
JAB ZEIN SE ZAMEEN PAR GIREY ZAINAB KE DULARE

MAA KEHTI THI SUB SE KE GAYE CHORD KE TANHA
